newsitem.title: USA: FDA finds Cor Integrilin data insufficient.
newsitem.headline: FDA finds Cor Integrilin data insufficient.

text.p: COR Therapeutics Inc said it received a letter from the U.S. Food and Drug Administration informing it that data it submitted on its Integrilin drug candidate was insufficient to support approval.
Integrilin is a "clot busting" drug designed to prevent cardiac ischemic complications in patients undergoing angioplasty.

COR said that later this year it will have new data on the drug from a 10,900 patient, Phase III trial of integrilin as a treatment for use in patients with unstable angina and myocardial infarction. It said it plans to file an amendment with the FDA addressing the concerns raised in the letter.
